mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has fallen in each of the last three weekly readings (-35.1 to -43.4). This persistent downward momentum reflects an ongoing reduction in discretionary outings that will continue to depress RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks absent a new countervailing shock.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC fell from -35.1 to -43.4 over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days is higher than the last 28 days despite three consecutive weeks of decline preceding the decision point.

mechanism_narrative: The decision date of mid-March 2022 falls shortly before the start of Ramadan (early April), a period historically associated with anticipatory shopping surges in Singapore. This seasonal pre-Ramadan stocking and apparel/food shopping should begin lifting RETAIL_REC within the next four weeks regardless of the recent downward trend.
evidence_refs: fact:decision date 2022-03-15 is within four weeks of Ramadan onset
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days remains lower than the prior 28 days despite the approach of Ramadan, indicating no seasonal uplift.
